RECITALS: A. Reference is made to that certain Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement,dated as of September7,2012 andrecorded September 18,2012intheRegister's Office under CRFN 2012000398746 (the “Original ZLDA"), by and between Owner, as thc fee owner of the real property located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 13 in Block 51 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described in “Exhibit A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof, and 22 Thames Street LLC, as predecessor in interest Henry II Thames LP, as predecessor in interest to Developer in the fee interest of the real property located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 14 in Block 51 on the Tax Map and more particularly described in "Exhibit B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof. B. Owner and Developer desire to modify the Original ZLDA in the manner set forth herein. NOW, THEREFORE,in consideration of the terms and conditions of this Amendment andfor other good andvaluable consideration,thereceipt and sufficiency ofwhichis hereby acknowledged, the parties hereby amend the Original ZLDA as follows: 1. The Original ZLDA is hereby modified to add a new Section 3(b)(v) with the followinglanguage: "Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, Owner agrces that until the earlier of (x) the date thatDeveloper obtains a temporary certificate of occupancy for the entire Developer Building (the “TCQ"); or (y) July 1, 2019 (the period prior thereto, the “"Restricted Period"), Owner shall not submit an application to DOB for a building permit that would convert to, utilize or incorporate residential Owner Parcel (the “Residential Use Permit").Notwithstanding the foregoing, Owner may submit an application to the DOB for a Residential Use Permit during theRestrictedPeriodprovided that Owner delivers toDeveloper, at least 20 days before submitting such application, a Zoning Resolution Determination (the "Determination") approved by the DOB's Technical Affairs Unit, which Determination shall confirm that if Owner obtains the Residential UsePermit prior to Developer obtaining the TCO, Developer will not be delayed or prevented from receiving or maintaining a building permit or the TCO that allows 359,500 square feet of residential floor area to be incorporated into the Developer NY243779123v8

Building. The Determination shall not be predicated upon the Developer Building containing any recreation space ("Recreation Space"), pursuant to Section 91-23 of the Zoning Resolution, or providing access to Recreation Space on Owner Parcel. Following the Restricted Period, there shall be no limits on Owner's ability to convert to, utilize and incorporate residential uses on the Owner Parcel, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement." 2.  All capitalized terms used herein and not defined herein shall have the meaning set forth in the Original ZLDA.  3. Except as expressly amended, the Original ZLDA shall continue in full force and effect and is hereby ratified and confirmed in all respects by the parties hereto. All references in P          ,     ZLDA, as amended by this Amendment. 4. This Amendment may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall, when executed, be deemed to be an original and all of which shall be deemed to be one and the same instrument. 5. All of the provisions of this Amendment shall bind, and inure to the benefit of, each of the parties hereto and their respective successors.  6.  In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between the Original ZLDA and this Amendment, the provisions of this Amendment shall govern and control. [SIGNATUREPAGE FOLLOWS] NY243779123v8
